report_md:
## Vacancy finding — 2701 San Pablo Ave, Oakland (APN 003 000300400)

**Verdict:** unknown (confidence 0.35). The parcel is a 5,780 sq. ft. commercial building. A July 2025 Bay Area Air Quality Management District notice documents a soil-vapor-extraction operation at the address. A City of San Pablo business-license report lists Cooper and Hawkins Engineering Inc. at the address with an active license through August 12, 2026. Oakland's 2017-2018 commercial facility list also names T & L Meat Market there. These records indicate past business use and site activity, but do not establish that a tenant currently occupies the building.

**Vacancy start:** not confirmed. **Duration:** unknown. The public evidence reviewed does not show a reliable vacancy date or establish continuous vacancy. The 2025 remediation notice reflects site work, not tenant occupancy; the business-license record expired before the current research date. No current listing, utility record, or recent dated street-level observation was located.

Sources: [BAAQMD July 2025 public notice](https://www.baaqmd.gov/~/media/files/engineering/public-notices/2025/722493/fid19967_nsr_722493_pn_070125-pdf.pdf?rev=aa12558d71574d58a9efc8e482c355d0&sc_lang=en), [City of San Pablo July 2025 business-license report](https://sanpabloca.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/3378), [Oakland 2017-2018 industrial and commercial facilities report](https://cao-94612.s3.amazonaws.com/documents/Oakland_2017-18_MRP_AR.pdf).
